source.snippet: Salesforce developer asking about API v67 Summer '26 change to Apex execution mode (system mode vs user mode) inside triggers — conflicting documentation causing uncertainty about security/sharing behavior in production orgs.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers and architects cannot quickly determine the security implications of the Summer '26 API v67 Apex user-mode change for their existing trigger code, risking data exposure or broken automation in production orgs.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and technical architects at companies running custom Apex on API v67+
notes: Salesforce orgs upgrading API versions is a recurring paid-consultant engagement. A tool or service that automatically audits Apex triggers for mode-related breaking changes post-upgrade has clear enterprise buyer. Single signal but high-value context.
